title: Turtle Travel
description: A cinematic ocean journey imagining the first adventure of baby sea turtles as they make their way to the deep blue sea.
intro: How to Write Film Music for Sea Turtles?
story: Turtle Travel imagines a small film score for an imaginary turtle documentary: baby sea turtles hatch on the beach and begin their journey toward the ocean. It explores wonder, movement and the emotional pull of the sea through orchestral storytelling.
